@title AttestationOracle
 @notice k-of-n EIP-712 signer multisig that gates `IntentQueue` attestations.
 @dev   Off-chain signers each independently observe partner-network
        deposits/withdrawals and sign an EIP-712 `Attestation` typed-data
        message with their HSM-backed key. A keeper aggregates ≥
        `threshold` signatures and posts them via `attest`. The oracle
        recovers each signer, deduplicates, checks active membership,
        and on success forwards the attestation to {IntentQueue}.
        Why batched (single-call) submission rather than per-signer
        accumulation: simpler state (no in-progress signature storage),
        single revert path for all-or-nothing atomicity, less SSTORE
        per attestation. Cost: a keeper has to coordinate the batch
        off-chain, but that's the off-chain stack's job anyway.
